_doc: Ultimates are a separate system unlocked by story flag ult_unlocked. Each has evolution levels bought with milestone points (50-pt game, game winner, triple-double...).

deepStepback.name: Deep Step-Back
deepStepback.desc: From around the 3PT line, an explosive step-back into deep-3 range. The next shot ignores most of the contest.

ftTakeoff.name: Free-Throw-Line Takeoff
ftTakeoff.desc: Driving within ~19 ft, take off from the free-throw line and fly in for a dunk that nearly can't be stopped.

chaseDown.name: Chase-Down Block
chaseDown.desc: Lock onto the ball handler. You get a burst of speed, and blocking from behind becomes possible (normally very hard).
